events.title: 애스턴 빌라 moved into third place and are three points short of the top of the Premier League after a 2–0 home win over QPR.

Goals from Paul Merson and 이언 라이트 give 아스널 a 2–1 win over 크리스털 팰리스 at Selhurst Park , and send the Gunners into third place, just one point behind 블랙번 로버스 and 노리치 시티. Victory for Palace would have lifted the hosts out of the relegation zone on goal difference.

Midweek fixtures in Division One produce a series of dramatic results. 반즐리 win 5–1 away to 브리스틀 로버스. Cambridge and Luton draw 3–3 at the Abbey Stadium . 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 and 포츠머스 draw 5–5 at the Manor Ground. Peterborough climb to the brink of the playoff places with a 2–1 win over 왓퍼드 at Vicarage Road . 더비 카운티's recovery continues with a 2–0 win over local rivals 노츠 카운티 at Meadow Lane .

리즈 유나이티드 play 레인저스 at Elland Road in the second leg of their second round UEFA Champions League tie. Trailing 2–1 from the first leg in Glasgow , Leeds went into the return match strongly favoured to turn the tie around. However, 레인저스 defied expectations and won 2–1 again on the night to progress to the first ever group stages of the Champions League.

아스널 go top of the Premier League with a 3–0 home win over 코번트리 시티. 애스턴 빌라 boost their challenge with a 1–0 home win over 맨체스터 유나이티드, who are now 10th in the table and have won none of their last seven league games, their worst run the league for three years. Their local rivals 맨체스터 시티 beat 리즈 유나이티드 4–0 at Maine Road – the same result which occurred in the clash between the two teams there last season. 리버풀 beat 미들즈브러 4–1 at Anfield. Peterborough continue their surprise push for a playoff place in Division One by beating 선덜랜드 5–2 at London Road . 울버햄프턴 원더러스 beat 브리스틀 로버스 5–1 at the Molineux to keep their promotion challenge strong.
Mark Robins scores a hat-trick for 노리치 시티 in their 3–2 away win over 올덤 애슬레틱, which takes the Canaries back to the top of the Premier League.
Dennis Rofe resigns as manager of Division One strugglers 브리스틀 로버스, and is succeeded by 65-year-old Malcolm Allison on an interim basis.
Graham 배로 is given the 체스터 시티 manager's job on a permanent basis.

The forthcoming international fixtures mean that there is no Premier League action this weekend, but it is business as usual in the Football League. Luton remain the drop zone and in danger of a second successive relegation following a 4–0 defeat Oxford. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 remain in pole position with a 3–1 win at Charlton, who have dropped to seventh following a recent downturn in form.
Transfer-listed 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 striker Micky Quinn joins 코번트리 시티 on a month's loan.
England achieve a comfortable 4–0 win over Turkey in the second World Cup qualifying game. 윔블던 midfielder 비니 존스 is fined £20,000 for his appearance in the video Soccer's Hard Men .

The High Court rules that 리버풀 fan Tony Bland , 22, who suffered brain damage in the Hillsborough disaster in April 1989 and has been in a persistent vegetative state ever since, can have treatment withdrawn and be allowed to die.

맨체스터 유나이티드's seven-match winless Premier League run ends with a 3–0 home victory over 올덤 애슬레틱, with two goals from 마크 휴스 and another from 브라이언 매클레어 . 17-year-old midfielder Nicky Butt makes his debut for United as a substitute. Midfielder 닐 웨브 leaves Old Trafford after three years and returns to 노팅엄 포리스트 for £800,000. 노리치 시티 now have a four-point lead at the top of the Premier League, having beaten 셰필드 유나이티드 2–1 at Carrow Road. The bottom two clubs, 크리스털 팰리스 and 노팅엄 포리스트, draw 1–1 at Selhurst Park. The main action in Division sees 웨스트햄 유나이티드 beat Oxford 5–3 at Upton Park and Tranmere squander the chance to go second with a 4–0 defeat at Fratton Park to a 포츠머스 side who are closing in on the playoff places.
맨체스터 유나이티드 sign 리즈 유나이티드 and France striker 에리크 캉토나 in a £1.2 million deal.
65-year-old former 맨체스터 시티 manager Malcolm Allison is appointed team manager by 브리스틀 로버스.

애스턴 빌라's 12-match unbeaten run is ended when they lose 3–2 at home to 노리치 시티, who now have a five-point lead over their nearest challengers 블랙번 로버스. Elsewhere in the Premier League, 마크 휴스 scores the only goal as 맨체스터 유나이티드 win at the 아스널, and at Ewood Park , Alan Shearer's goal helps the Rovers overcome the 레인저스 1–0. 크리스털 팰리스 remain second from bottom with just one victory to their name after being beaten 5–0 by 리버풀 at Anfield. Oldham move two more places clear of the relegation zone with a 4–1 win over 미들즈브러 at Boundary Park. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 maintain their runaway lead at the top of Division One with a 4–1 home win over 케임브리지 유나이티드.
첼시 move into fifth place in the Premier League with a 1–0 win over Leeds at Stamford Bridge .

노리치 시티 finish November as Premier League leaders, leading 블랙번 로버스 by five points. 크리스털 팰리스 and 노팅엄 포리스트 continue to prop up the top flight, while 에버턴 have climbed out of the relegation zone at the expense of 윔블던. In Division One, leaders 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 now have a 12-point lead over their nearest contenders, 트랜미어 로버스 (in the hunt for top-flight football for the first time in their history, which would give them three promotions in just five seasons). The playoff zone is occupied by 웨스트햄 유나이티드, 스윈던 타운, 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and 밀월. A surprise promotion challenge is coming from 그림즈비 타운 (who were playing in the old Fourth Division three years ago) who now occupy eighth place in Division One. The relegation zone is unchanged from the end of October, except for 루턴 타운 having climbed a point above another team fighting two successive relegations, 노츠 카운티. UEFA announces that UEFA Euro 1996 , held in England, will be contested by 16 teams, doubling the number of entrants from the traditional eight.
